title: Known hosts
description: The SSH servers Git may connect to. Before any connection, the server's key must match one listed here: an unlisted or changed key is refused.
emptyDescription: Add the Git servers your services clone from over SSH. HTTPS needs nothing here.
hostHint: As it appears in the repository address, such as git.example.com.
found: Compare these with what your Git host publishes before trusting them.
publicKeyHint: Or paste the key your Git host publishes, or a line from a known_hosts file.
removeDescription: Connections to this server fail unless another of its keys is listed.

errors.hostInvalid: Enter a host name such as git.example.com.
errors.keyRequired: Paste a public key such as ssh-ed25519 AAAA...
